top_signals.title: Nomura Says Back-to-Back ECB Hikes Could Boost Euro in Q4
top_signals.summary: The possibility of back-to-back interest rate hikes by the European Central Bank could lift the euro, helping it hit Nomura International’s year-end target of $1.20, Dominic Bunning, head of G10 FX strategy, says during an interview on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Copper’s Rally Stalls as Worries About Global Economy Resurface
top_signals.summary: Copper fell to the lowest in more than a week, dropping with other metals, as resurgent oil prices fanned concerns about prospects for the world economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Russia Pauses Grain Export Duty as Black Sea Exports Stall
top_signals.summary: Russia suspended the floating export duty on wheat, barley and corn through the end of 2026 as Ukrainian attacks disrupted shipments through the Black and Azov seas, affecting routes for more than 70% of exports.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan’s Peters Says Yields at 5% Could Put Stocks at Risk
top_signals.summary: Rising bond yields pose a key risk to global equities as they navigate the historically weak month of September, according to JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s Grace Peters.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: From yoga to Hyrox, Lululemon taps Asian trends with new Tokyo store
How Japan’s bond rout is turning the tide of global capital
top_signals.summary: While there's no sign of Japan dumping its $2.4 trillion hoard in overseas debt yet, global fund managers and a growing body of data is showing a steadier drawdown is underway.

top_signals.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
top_signals.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
